services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From a single vehicle to regular company orders — we have the right solution.
services.card1Desc: Cars, minibuses and commercial vehicles up to 3,500 kg — safely loaded, delivered on time.
services.card2Desc: Reliable transport of goods throughout Switzerland and Europe.
services.card3Desc: Complete handling incl. customs clearance, import and export documents for all EU member states.
services.card4Desc: Priority processing, dedicated client portal, billing overview — for regular orders.

pricing.title: How Your Price is Calculated
pricing.subtitle: No fixed price — because every transport is unique. We calculate fairly and transparently.
pricing.factor1Desc: Distance between pickup and delivery location in Switzerland or EU.
pricing.factor2Desc: The type and size of the vehicle or goods determines the effort.
pricing.factor3Desc: The total weight influences the choice of transport equipment.
pricing.factor4Desc: Narrow roads, difficult parking areas or special on-site requirements.
